rows.traditional: A 同 B 一齊 V 嘅
rows.jyutping: A tung4 B jat1 cai4 V ge3
rows.note: Use this all-purpose construction when saying that two or more people or organisations jointly carried out an action.

example.english: The report was a joint effort by Ming and me.
example.traditional: 我同阿明一齊整呢份報告嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 jat1 cai4 zing2 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a body joint and can also describe a rotating joint in a mechanical structure.

example.english: The joint in my hand hurts.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 ge3 gwaan1 zit3 tung3

rows.note: Use this for a fixed structural connection, especially where pipes or other components are joined together.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 seoi2 hau4 bok3 hau2 lau6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a marijuana cigarette rather than an ordinary cigarette.

example.english: They were smoking a joint in the back alley.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 hau6 hong6 sik6 daai6 maa4 jin1

rows.note: Use this for the prison or jail sense, especially in colloquial speech.

example.english: He got hauled off to the joint.
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2 jap6 gaam1 cong1
